title: The Prime Sieve as a Stack of Orthogonal Periodic Fields
pitch: An interactive essay on the periodic machinery underneath the primes: each prime emits an orthogonal exclusion field, their stacked product has primorial period, and CRT independence makes density multiplicative, entropy additive, and spectral support disjoint.
